name: Preference
description: A fact or preference about a subject (usually the user) — 'likes Python', 'allergic to peanuts', 'wants remote-only jobs'.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: 0..1 confidence that this fact is accurate/current.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Where this fact came from (e.g. 'user said', 'inferred').

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Loose ties to other things, for what no attribute or relation says: everything about the move, everyone from that conference.

methods.name: update_value
methods.description: Replace `value`, e.g. when the user's preference changes.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Set confidence to 1.0, e.g. after the user explicitly confirms it.

what_to_say: what the preference is and how strong
